title: Travel / space poster: a dark sky, a planet limb with halftone, a swept rocket (or satellite) glyph on a diagonal, a slanted condensed title, a vermilion band
use: Travel and event posters, launch announcements, season key art.

art.note: slot: a period scene image replaces the glyph

halftone.note: code dot screen on the planet

art.note: period scene (launch, Earth, Moon), 2:1.8; from a public-domain period source or a task sheet

emblem.note: mark slot for the owner's logo, insignia or emblem file (PNG or SVG with alpha), placed with fit contain; square, 0.13 of the width, top right; keep clear space of 0.25 of its side; never drawn by the template

relations: Title top left at the margin (0.055 W), up to 0.17 of H, slanted; kicker and subtitle on the same left line.
Planet limb: a disc of radius 1.05 W centred below the frame (0.62 W); the rocket crosses at -32 degrees, 0.62 W long, trail to the lower left.
Band 0.1 of H at the foot, vermilion, charcoal tracked caps.
decoration: seeded four-point stars, the planet with a code dot screen and a misregistered plate, a dashed orbit ellipse, the rocket or satellite glyph

provenance.corpus: atomic-age kit (Halcyon Orbital Lines): our own original world in the atomic-age grammar, examples/atomic-age-kit
provenance.experiment: styles/atomic-age/style.json provenance (owner-supplied mood board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: k-means palette (6 clusters, OKLab-free RGB on a 160 px reduction), light and dark shares, visual-weight centre and proportions read on the board's satellite_poster, book_cover_dark, shuttle_mars panel
